# Tranzmit AI

> Tranzmit AI builds self-improving interfaces that increase conversion for consumer platforms. It is starting with monetization — paywalls and App Store pages — helping consumer companies automatically improve conversion and revenue.

People spend nearly 8 hours a day on screens, and trillions of dollars of spending decisions happen through those interfaces. But today, every user still sees roughly the same interface. Tranzmit replaces that one-size-fits-all guesswork with a continuous, evidence-based system: it builds, tests, and evolves revenue surfaces using behavioral data, simulation beds, and safe live rollout to find winning screens 50x faster and with less risk. It continuously learns what converts and ships the winners automatically, lifting conversion and revenue with little to no engineering effort. It is used by consumer subscription apps across the US and India.

## How paywall optimization works with Tranzmit (signal to shipped winner)

Tranzmit runs a continuous closed loop:

- **Analyze** — Ingests real user signals and product events in real time: behavioral signals, intent & value, source & device, and user segments.
- **Generate** — Creates multiple paywall variants across offers, layouts, and copy.
- **Score** — Evaluates each variant with simulation (projected uplift), VLM judges (quality & clarity), and historical conversion data (empirical signal).
- **Ship** — Safely rolls out the winning variant with guardrails (revenue, churn, errors) and automatic rollback, ramping traffic 25% → 50% → 100%.

## Results

- 20,000+ paywalls indexed into a conversion map
- +57% average uplift from control
- +130% best customer uplift
- 9.4 minutes median time to a winning direction
- Case study — Jungle AI: +62% paywall conversion uplift, more than $20,000 of value proven, with zero engineering
- Case study — Influish: +82% paywall click-through rate, +49% subscription conversion, 1.5x topline revenue
- HiAstro case study: 25% uplift in paywall click-through rates, measured across more than 400,000 users within two weeks of going live

## Integrations

Works with the analytics tools teams already use:

- **PostHog** — capture events and feature usage
- **Mixpanel** — understand user journeys and funnels
- **Amplitude** — deep behavioral analytics and cohorts

Plus Segment, Firebase, RevenueCat, and anything that can send an event.

## India

Tranzmit works with Indian apps, including HiAstro and TATA 1mg. Paywalls can show rupee pricing and localized offers and can run in Indian languages such as Hindi. Tranzmit does not process payments or run UPI mandates; it sits on top of billing tools. HiAstro's one-rupee trial now shows the exact charge timeline instead of hiding it.

- [Paywalls for Indian apps](https://tranzmitai.com/paywalls-for-indian-apps)

## Common questions about paywall optimization

- **What is paywall optimization?** Systematically testing and improving the screen where users decide to subscribe or pay, so a larger share of visitors convert to buyers. Tranzmit automates this with AI variant generation, simulation-based scoring, and safe live rollout.
- **How is this different from manual A/B testing?** Traditional A/B testing is slow and hand-run. Tranzmit continuously generates variants, scores them (simulation + VLM judges + historical conversion data), and ships winners automatically with guardrails and auto-rollback — reducing both time-to-winner and risk.
- **Who is it for?** Product and growth teams at consumer subscription apps that want to increase paywall conversion and revenue without heavy engineering work.
